accounting.addressing: version index and label/rule catalogs charged; neither is parameter memory
accounting.comparable_budgets: single rank rounded up to match or exceed fixed multi plus learned router
accounting.growth_cost_unit: declared accuracy utility; these are assumed resource prices, not measured currency
accounting.model_base: report full cold base and shared incremental artifacts separately
accounting.retained_sources: sources, replay, rejected candidates and migration charged explicitly
accounting.timing: one machine CPU batches; no tail-latency or production throughput claim

boundaries: pretrained MiniLM is frozen; trainable small heads are not transformer weight fine-tuning
canonical key reads and task cues do not establish open-ended conversational memory
composition task schemas, interpreter and ports are supplied
no validated local unlearning: tainted descendants require clean reinitialization
exact maps and kNN are strong separately measured baselines
negative results and failed runs must be preserved

structural_evolution.same_optimizer_work_causal_isolation: not established by priced cost alone

pretrained_inference_contract.development_issue: original quantized encoder changed 4 of 190 semantic predictions after regrouping; old failed run and diagnosis preserved
pretrained_inference_contract.invariance: query features must not depend on grouping or other requests

seed_semantics.external: repeated grouped data splits of three fixed datasets; not fifteen domains
seed_semantics.growth: independent synthetic association streams and optimization seeds
seed_semantics.real: repeated fixed repository source with query partitions and initialization changes; not independent source domains
seed_semantics.routing: known cue and synonym fixtures; seed varies keys and initialization, not independent language domains

statistics.five_seeds_limit: small repeated-trial interval, not a population guarantee
statistics.inference_unit: seed conditional on each fixed workload; external domain count is three
statistics.real_primary: macro average of semantic/episodic/procedural hidden task accuracies
